stem.text: The amount of oil in a holding tank changes at the rate \( A'(t) = 18 \cos{\left(\frac{\pi t}{8} \right)} + 6 \) barrels per hour for \( 0 \le t \le 16 \). At time \( t = 0 \) there are 50 barrels of oil in the tank, and t is measured in hours. Using a calculator, find the time in \( 0 \le t \le 16 \) at which the amount A(t) of oil is greatest, and justify the answer. Show the setup for the calculations.

answer_key.label: The amount is greatest at t = 16, where A is 146 barrels, the largest of the values of A at t = 0, at both critical points and at t = 16.

worked_solution.text: The amount is \( A(t) = 50 + \int_{0}^{t} \left(18 \cos{\left(\frac{\pi s}{8} \right)} + 6\right)\,ds \), so \( A'(t) = 18 \cos{\left(\frac{\pi t}{8} \right)} + 6 \). Setting \( A'(t) = 0 \) and solving with a calculator gives \( t = 4.865 \) and \( t = 11.135 \) in the interval.
worked_solution.rule_named: critical points of an accumulation function

worked_solution.text: The candidates are the critical points and both endpoints: \( A(0) = 50 \), \( A(4.865) \approx 122.408 \), \( A(11.135) \approx 73.592 \), and \( A(16) = 50 + \int_{0}^{16} A'(s)\,ds = 146 \).
The largest candidate value is 146, at the endpoint, so the amount is greatest at \( t = 16 \) hours.
